scientific_integrity: Proof of the universal finite-time bound is self-contained; asymptotic existence and Gaussian conclusion cite and apply the published Lemma 2.3 and Theorem 2.7, not an independent derivation of those earlier statements.
scientific_limitations: Assumes independent fair refresh, synchronous copying, local finite degree and positive refresh probability; optimality for interior noise and exact limiting variance are not asserted. Two related sources compared via abstracts only; independent validation not performed.
title: Universal linear variance for temporal repetitions in the noisy voter model
